findings.title: Migration crashes when no `embed_category` setting row exists
findings.description: The query result is indexed with `[0]['id']` without checking that a row came back. `site_settings` only stores non-default values, so on a fresh install or any site that never set `embed_category` (or set a name that matches no category) the result is empty. `PG::Result#[]` (pg 0.18.1) raises `IndexError` for an out-of-range tuple, so `db:migrate` aborts. The `category_id == 0` fallback on line 14 is unreachable in exactly the case it was written for. Line 15 has the same unguarded `[0]['value']` pattern. Guard with `cmd_tuples > 0`, as line 19 already does for the hosts query.

findings.title: Migrated hosts are inserted un-normalised, so previously valid configs stop matching
findings.description: The old setting accepted values such as `http://eviltrout.com` or `https://example.com/1234`; the removed `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` and its specs covered them. The migration copies each line verbatim with raw SQL, bypassing the model's `before_validation` stripping in `app/models/embeddable_host.rb:5-8`. `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` then compares `lower(host)` against a bare hostname, so those rows never match and embedding is rejected with "invalid referer host" after upgrade. Stray whitespace or `\r` from the textarea setting has the same effect. Strip scheme, path and whitespace before inserting.

findings.title: Migration builds SQL by string interpolation
findings.description: `'#{h}'` is interpolated straight from a stored setting value. A value containing a single quote breaks the migration, and it is an injection vector from admin-controlled data. Quote the value (`ActiveRecord::Base.connection.quote`) or use a parameterised insert.

findings.title: Migration is irreversible but declared as `change`, with `force: true`
findings.description: The method mixes `create_table` with data-moving `execute` calls and a `DELETE` of the old settings inside `change`, so rollback cannot work. `force: true` silently drops any existing `embeddable_hosts` table. Use explicit `up`/`down` (or raise `IrreversibleMigration`) and drop `force: true`.

findings.title: Host lookup and validation have several correctness gaps
findings.description:
- **Case:** `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` lowers the column but not the argument. Ruby's `URI#host` preserves case, so a mixed-case referer or embed URL fails to match.
- **Nil host:** `self.host.sub!` in `before_validation` raises `NoMethodError` when `host` is nil, giving a 500 instead of a validation error.
- **Ports:** the regex accepts `:port`, but `URI#host` never includes the port, so a host saved with a port can never match.
- **TLD length:** `[a-z]{2,5}` rejects longer TLDs (`.museum`, `.photography`) and `localhost`.
- **Dead and loose regex parts:** the `(\/.*)?` branch is unreachable because paths are stripped first, and `\Z` permits a trailing newline (use `\z`).
- **Duplicates:** there is no uniqueness validation or index on `host`, so duplicate hosts with different categories make `.first` (and the topic category chosen in `app/models/topic_embed.rb:36`) non-deterministic.
- **Return type:** `record_for_host` returns `false` in two branches and a record or `nil` in the third. It works only because `false.try(:category_id)` is nil on Rails 4.1; return `nil` consistently.

findings.title: Admin controller returns 500 for missing records or params
findings.description: `EmbeddableHost.where(id: ...).first` returns nil for an unknown id, after which `host.destroy` (line 16) and `host.host =` (line 23) raise `NoMethodError`. `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` also raises when the root key is absent. Use `find`/`find_by` with a 404, and `params.require(:embeddable_host)`. `category_id` is not checked to reference an existing category. The `before_filter :ensure_logged_in, :ensure_staff` on line 3 duplicates what `Admin::AdminController` already declares.

findings.title: New controllers have no behavioural tests
findings.description: Both new controller specs (this one and `spec/controllers/admin/embedding_controller_spec.rb`) assert only that the class inherits from `Admin::AdminController`. Create, update, destroy, validation failure, the uncategorized fallback, and the admin-only constraint are untested. The migration's data-moving logic also has no coverage, which is where the two FAIL findings sit.

findings.title: `find embedded` JS test passes only because the stub ignores the id
findings.description: The test now requests `store.find('fruit', 2)` and asserts two colours with ids 1 and 2. Fruit 2 (banana) has `color_ids: [3]` in `test/javascripts/helpers/create-pretender.js.es6:43`. The assertions pass only because the `/fruits/:id` handler at line 227 of that file always returns `fruits[0]`. Either request id 1 or make the stub honour the id.

findings.title: `_ids` hydration is fragile and inconsistent with the singular branch
findings.description:
- `obj[k].map` throws if any `*_ids` key in a rest-serialised payload is null or not an array; the regex now captures every such key.
- `hydrated || []` is dead code, since `map` always returns an array.
- Ids not found in the root are left as `undefined` holes in the array.
- The original key is always deleted and replaced, whereas the singular branch only replaces when the lookup succeeds.

Guard with `Array.isArray`, and filter or skip misses.

findings.title: Type-name drift patched with a single-underscore replace
findings.description: Side-loaded children are hydrated with the underscored subtype from the key (`embeddable_host`), while `createRecord('embeddable-host')` in `app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6:10` uses the dasherised name. The same model therefore lives under two keys in the identity map and resolves two different `model:`/`adapter:` lookups. `type.replace('_', '-')` papers over this in `basePath` only, and replaces just the first underscore. Normalise the type once (for example `Ember.String.dasherize(subType)` in `_hydrateEmbedded`) rather than at the adapter.

findings.title: Fabricator file contents are swapped
findings.description: `category_fabricator.rb` now holds the `:embeddable_host` fabricator, and `spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb` holds all the category fabricators. It still loads, but it is misleading and makes the diff look like the category fabricators were deleted. Swap them back.

findings.title: Saved host shows no category when none was chosen; delete errors are swallowed
findings.description: When a host is saved without a category, the server falls back to the uncategorized category and returns its `category_id`. The component then sets `category` from the local `categoryId` (null), so the row renders an empty category until reload; use the returned `host.get('category_id')` instead. Separately, `destroyRecord()` in `delete` has no `.catch(popupAjaxError)`, unlike `save`, so a failed delete gives the admin no feedback.

findings.title: Stale test names and setup in `expandable_first_post?` specs
findings.description: `expandable_first_post?` no longer consults embeddable hosts, so "is false if embeddable_host is blank" passes only because of default settings and no longer tests what it names. `Fabricate(:embeddable_host)` in the nested `before` is irrelevant, and `'with an emeddable host'` has a typo. The describe label `"allows_embeddable_host"` in `spec/models/embeddable_host_spec.rb:23` also refers to the removed method.

findings.title: No-op update endpoint and unused pieces
findings.description: `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` only re-renders the same payload. Its `PUT` route and the `saveChanges` action in `admin-embedding.js.es6` are not wired to anything in `embedding.hbs`. The `admin.embedding.edit` locale key is unused. The explicit `id`/`host`/`category_id` methods in `EmbeddableHostSerializer` restate what `attributes` already does. `embeddable-host.js.es6` imports from `ember-computed-decorators` on two separate lines.

findings.title: Old setting references are fully removed from code
findings.description: A search of Ruby, JS and template sources finds no remaining callers of `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts`, `SiteSetting.embed_category` or `allows_embeddable_host?`, and both settings are gone from `config/site_settings.yml`. `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` and `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?` use the new `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?`. The new routes carry `AdminConstraint`, and the `admin.embedding.*` keys used by the templates exist in `config/locales/client.en.yml:2494-2500`.
